observations: Blue toy electronic keyboard/piano with 5 colored key sections visible (black key tops).
Front has cartoon animal graphics and a circular speaker/control area on the right side.
Back shows a label area but the text is not readable in the photo.
No visible power adapter/battery compartment details, no accessories shown.

claims.claim: A blue electronic piano with all blue songs and other songs preloaded
claims.evidence: Photos show a toy electronic piano, but there is no screen/label or proof of the song library.
No photo shows the mode/buttons or any demonstration of Do-Re-Mi teaching.

risks.risk: Whether it actually works (sound, keys, and built-in songs) and whether volume/speaker function correctly.
risks.proof: A short video clip showing power-on and pressing multiple keys with audible sound (and ideally the Do-Re-Mi mode if present).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed working (worst case: needs repair or does not produce sound).

risks.risk: Power source uncertainty (batteries vs charger/adapter) and whether the correct power accessory is included.
risks.proof: Photo of the battery compartment and/or the charging port label, plus a photo of included charger/battery (if any).
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming buyer may need to supply batteries/adapter.

risks.risk: Model/brand mismatch affecting value (the back label text is unreadable).
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the back label/model number and any brand name.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at a generic toy electronic keyboard level (lowest comparable).

risks.risk: Missing parts/accessories (e.g., charger, battery cover, instruction card) or physical damage not visible in these angles.
risks.proof: Full set of photos: front, back, sides, and close-ups of any ports/hinges; include what accessories are included in one photo.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown condition beyond what’s visible.

proof_requests: Video: power-on + pressing several keys with audible sound (showing it plays the preloaded songs).
Clear close-up of the back label/model number and any brand name.
Photo of battery compartment/charging port and what power accessory is included (charger/batteries).
Photos of all sides and close-ups of ports/buttons to confirm no damage and completeness.
response.reason: The photos confirm it’s a toy electronic piano, but the key value drivers (working condition, power source/accessories, and exact model) are not verifiable from the images alone.
